title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Billed Minutes for Late Pickups, 2026-27
content:
Under the board-approved 2026-27 late pickup fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, the billed minutes of a chargeable late pickup follow how late the pickup was. The minutes late are those recorded on the pickup, counted from the plan's after-school close time.

- **More than 30 minutes late:** billed in whole quarter hours of 15 minutes, any part of a quarter hour counting as a whole one. The minutes late are rounded up to the next multiple of 15.
- **No more than 10 minutes late:** billed the minimum block of 10 minutes.
- **Any other pickup (11 through 30 minutes late):** billed by the minute as recorded.

## Billed minutes by minutes late

| Minutes late recorded | Band | Billed minutes |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | no more than 10 | 10 |
| 10 | no more than 10 | 10 |
| 11 | 11 through 30 | 11 |
| 30 | 11 through 30 | 30 |
| 31 | more than 30 | 45 |
| 45 | more than 30 | 45 |
| 46 | more than 30 | 60 |
| 61 | more than 30 | 75 |

## Boundaries

- 10 minutes late is billed as the minimum block of 10, and 11 minutes is billed as 11.
- 30 minutes late is billed as 30. At 31 minutes the quarter-hour billing begins, and the minutes are rounded up to 45.
- A pickup exactly on a quarter hour above 30 (45, 60, 75) is billed as recorded, because no part of a further quarter hour is reached.
